name: Brawler — top-view 3D fighting (c44763af regression)
description: Replays the May-3 c44763af case. The original run took 6 corrections to recover from 'topview' -> orthographic + 'L/R hand' -> side-arc misreads. Post-V2 must converge with <= 2 corrections + checkEngineFit gate must reject pygame for fighting + 3d.
brief: Create a topview 3D fighting game where two characters can punch with left and right hand attacks. Win when opponent HP hits zero.
